fato_historico: 1780: American Revolutionary War: John André, a British Army officer, is hanged as a spy by the Continental Army.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos suggests you embrace your fluid nature today. Much like a secret message drifting through time, your intuition may reveal hidden truths. It is a good time to release old burdens, perhaps even those that feel like heavy historical chains, and focus on the magic of new beginnings. Trust your inner voice as you navigate these gentle emotional waters.
frase_do_dia: Let go of the past to embrace the infinite possibilities of the present moment.
significado_numero: Represents the awakening of spiritual wisdom and inner peace.
conselho: Consider taking a peaceful walk and breathing deeply into your beautiful, creative soul.
